== Summary ==
Page 17 of 40 (Effect cards) of '''''The Rules''''', the ''Star Wars Customizable Card Game'' rulebook packed in [[Premiere Limited|Premiere]] starter decks (© 1995 Decipher Inc.; printed in Belgium by Carta Mundi). Document page: [[Premiere starter deck rulebook]].

Source: the right half of <code>Rulebook_08_p16-17.tif</code> (a 600 dpi two-page spread, SHA-256 <code>3bf26744a40c9258ad14755da70e323add3c0f2cf8f5b79eadc30881ba5735b5</code>) in the folder [https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/15MVULZxbmcEeBmBOToMO1axiH2zLUUKW Rulebook (from Premiere Starter Deck)] of the public "SWCCG Scans" Google Drive folder (owner not shown), uploaded to Google Drive in April 2024 (file date 21 April 2024). Preserved copy of the folder: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261112195026/https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/15MVULZxbmcEeBmBOToMO1axiH2zLUUKW Internet Archive]. Cropped at the spine and saved as lossless PNG at the original resolution (1469 × 2067 pixels); no other changes.

Used on [[Premiere starter deck rulebook]].
